subject: Tri-party marketplace demo bridge — facilitator rotation & backstop plan
messages:
From: Amelia Byrne <amelia@cloudwave.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-14T15:23:00Z
Subject: Marketplace demo — tri-party runbook + ask on facilitator rotation

Hi Soojin & team,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the joint marketplace demo with CloudWave and Integrated SI next week. We put together a brief runbook (attached) and a draft agenda — wanted to surface a couple of coordination asks so we can lock invites: 

1) Facilitator rotation: because we have attendees in APAC (Singapore), EU (London) and US (PST), we'd like to rotate the facilitator every 30 minutes so the primary hand-off is always within the local region. Can Redwood provide two facilitators who can swap mid-demo?

2) Backup hosts: if the primary facilitator misses their slot, can you confirm a named backstop? Our SI (Integrated SI) also needs a fallback contact.

3) Runtime notes: the runbook includes two short failover flows — an audio-only graceful degrade and a demo-screen capture fallback. Please add anything you'd like us to own.

Attached: Marketplace_runbook_v1.pdf (pdf) — runbook, and tri-party-demo-agenda-draft.docx.

Proposed windows (all times in UTC):
- Option A: 2028-03-21 02:00–03:30 UTC (APAC-friendly)
- Option B: 2028-03-21 09:00–10:30 UTC (EMEA/US overlap)

If you can share facilitator names and a calendar owner, we’ll send calendar invites and a DocuSign NDA (if required).

Thanks — Amelia
Amelia Byrne
Partnerships, CloudWave Solutions

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Byrne <amelia@cloudwave.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@integratedsi.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-14T17:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace demo — tri-party runbook + ask on facilitator rotation

Amelia — thanks for the runbook and options. Quick answers and a proposed cadence: 

1) Facilitators: Vanessa Ortiz will be primary facilitator for the APAC-first hour; I (Sojin) will take the middle 30-minute slot overlap (EMEA/US transition). Vivek can be the backstop and will monitor chat and hands-on ops.

2) Backup hosts: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com) is the named backstop. For Integrated SI, Samir — can you confirm a backup on your side? If not, we can treat your primary as the fallback and Redwood will own the mute/host handover.

3) Agenda edits: I added two runbook items — (a) a 5-minute pre-demo connect call between hosts 20 minutes before start, and (b) a 3-minute post-demo quick sync for action items. I uploaded a draft agenda to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/example/tri-party-runbook

Proposed final window: Let’s go with Option B (2028-03-21 09:00–10:30 UTC). That gives us a reasonable overlap for EMEA and early US participants while still being usable in APAC. If Integrated SI has heavy APAC attendees, we can flip to Option A.

Action items for Redwood:
- Vanessa to accept facilitator primary for the APAC portion and confirm calendar owner (vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com).
- Vivek to be on-call as backstop and monitor chat.
- Karthik to confirm whether the runbook contains the auto-fallback model switch (quantized variant) we discussed — note for ops.

Attaching the runbook and agenda back to this thread after minor edits.

—Sojin
Soojin Lee
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Amelia Byrne <amelia@cloudwave.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@integratedsi.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-15T01:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace demo — tri-party runbook + ask on facilitator rotation

Quick confirmation: I’ll be on the call and monitoring the ops channel. For backstop handover, my recommendation: 
- Primary facilitator shares host rights 10 minutes before their slot (Zoom -> co-host transfer).
- If primary is unreachable at T+5, backstop takes floor and we drop into the audio-only fallback for 2 minutes while we sort screenshare.

Also flagged an ops note in the runbook: add an explicit step to pin the SI presenter 2 minutes before their demo so the stream doesn't hop participants.

If Samir can provide the name/email of their backup host, I’ll add them to the invite list and the pre-demo connect call.

-Vivek
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Byrne <amelia@cloudwave.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@integratedsi.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-16T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace demo — tri-party runbook + ask on facilitator rotation

All set — I accepted the draft agenda and will own calendar invites once Samir confirms his backup. I’ll create two calendar events: (1) Pre-demo host connect 20m prior (internal), (2) Main demo 09:00–10:30 UTC on 2028-03-21; calendar owner is vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com.

Samir — can you confirm whether Integrated SI prefers Nik Shah (nik.shah@integratedsi.com) or Rhea Nair (rhea.nair@integratedsi.com) as the backup host? If you confirm before EOD today (2028-03-16 23:59 UTC), I’ll send final invites and include the DocuSign link for the marketplace NDA.
